# Antigravity Gmail Plugin An official-grade Gmail plugin for **Google Antigravity** (CLI, IDE, and Desktop App), powered by Google's open-source **Google Workspace CLI (`@googleworkspace/cli` / `gws`)**.

## Features - **Inbox Triage**: Quickly summarize unread messages and highlight priority emails. - **Search & Retrieval**: Filter emails by query (`from:`, `is:unread`, `has:attachment`, date ranges, labels) and inspect headers or full message bodies. - **Drafting & Sending**: Draft or send new emails, reply to threads, and forward messages with automatic RFC 5322 MIME encoding and attachment support. - **Workflow Recipes**: Curated recipes to auto-label and archive, extract attachments to Drive, create vacation responders, and set up Gmail filters. - **Safety Guardrails**: Built-in rules requiring explicit user approval before sending or deleting any messages. - **Multi-Account Support**: Seamless switching between primary and secondary Google accounts. - **Universal Surface Support**: Works seamlessly across **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**, **Antigravity IDE**, and **Antigravity 2.0 Desktop App**. --- ## Prerequisites 1. **Node.js 18+** 2. **Google Workspace CLI (`gws`)**: ```bash npm install -g @googleworkspace/cli ``` 3. **Google Cloud OAuth Desktop Credentials**: - A Google Cloud Project with the **Gmail API** (`gmail.googleapis.com`) enabled. - A Desktop OAuth client ID saved to `~/.config/gws/client_secret.json`. --- ## Installation ### Option 1: Direct from GitHub (Antigravity CLI) ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/javiroca712/antigravity-gmail-plugin ``` ### Option 2: Local Discovery / Shared Global Config Clone or copy this directory directly into your Antigravity global plugin directory: ```bash git clone https://github.com/javiroca712/antigravity-gmail-plugin.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/gmail ``` Then enable it: ```bash agy plugin enable gmail ``` --- ## Authentication & Setup ### 1. One-Time Setup Authenticate your account with the Gmail scope: ```bash gws auth login -s gmail ``` Follow the browser prompt, check the permission box for Gmail, and complete the sign-in. Credentials are encrypted using AES-256-GCM in your OS keyring. Verify authentication anytime with: ```bash gws auth status ``` ### 2. Multi-Account Support To add a secondary account (e.g., work or alternate personal email), set `GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CONFIG_DIR`: ```bash # Windows PowerShell $env:GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CONFIG_DIR = "$env:USERPROFILE\.config\gws-secondary" gws auth login -s gmail ``` The agent automatically selects the right profile when you ask questions about your secondary account. --- ## Available Skills & Commands | Skill | Description | Helper Command | |---|---|---| | `gws-gmail` | Full Gmail resource management | `gws gmail --help` | | `gws-gmail-triage` | Summarize unread inbox messages | `gws gmail +triage` | | `gws-gmail-read` | Read email body, headers, and attachments | `gws gmail +read --id ` | | `gws-gmail-send` | Draft or send an email | `gws gmail +send --to ... --subject ...` | | `gws-gmail-reply` | Reply to an email thread | `gws gmail +reply --message-id ` | | `gws-gmail-reply-all` | Reply to all recipients on a thread | `gws gmail +reply-all --message-id ` | | `gws-gmail-forward` | Forward email to new recipients | `gws gmail +forward --message-id ` | | `gws-gmail-watch` | Stream incoming emails as NDJSON | `gws gmail +watch` | --- ## Example Prompts for Antigravity - *"Triage my unread emails from today and summarize the key action items."* - *"Search for any flight tickets or hotel confirmations in my secondary account."* - *"Draft a reply to the latest message from Alice confirming our meeting tomorrow at 10 AM."* - *"List all emails from the last 7 days with attachments larger than 5MB."* --- ## License Apache License 2.0 — See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for details.
